player_prompt.intro:
Inwe ni Player {player_id} katika mchezo wa Indian Poker.
- Deko la kadi 52; inwe unaweza kuona kadi ya mpinzani wako pekee.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) kila raundi, {max_rounds} raundi(s) kwa jumla.
- Mbinu zinazokubalika: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ni nambari kamili chanya <= hesabu ya chip zako.)
- Kadi iliyo na thamani ya juu zaidi inashinda poti katika matokeo.

round.announce:
### Raundi {current_round}/{max_rounds}
Kadi ya mpinzani wako ni: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Tafadhali toa kitendo kimoja tu kilichowekwa mabano, mfano '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', au '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Ok nyalre [check] - in gi wach mar bet.
invalid_move.amount_min: Pesa ma ng'ato nyalo keto e bet / raise nyaka bed ≥ 1.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Onge gima inyalo luongogo; to kar mano, inyalo [check].
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Ti gi [bet X] e yawo; onge pesa monego omedi.
